Canvas.FourPointsHint.zh: 临时隐藏工具条以外的窗口，依次点击四个角点。完成或按 Esc 取消后恢复窗口。
Canvas.FourPointsHint.en: Temporarily hide windows except the toolbar, then click four corners in any order. Windows return after completion or Esc cancellation.

Project.Reverted.zh: 已还原到上次保存的状态，可按 Ctrl+Z 撤销。
Project.Reverted.en: Restored the last saved state. Press Ctrl+Z to undo.
